source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 17 (PDF 85-117), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Alternating Current) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is meant by alternating current? Write the equation of an alternating voltage.
(Alternating current se kya murad hai? Alternating voltage ki masawat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Alternating current aisi current hai jo sine ya cosine function ki tarah waqt ke saath badalti hai. AC generator ka emf V = Vₒ sin ωt hai, jahan Vₒ peak voltage aur ω angular frequency (zaaviyai frequency) hai; isi tarah I = Iₒ sin ωt.

book_ref.quote: An alternating current AC means a sinusoidally varying current

blocks.prompt:
2 What two conditions must a periodically varying voltage satisfy to be called alternating?
(Waqfe waqfe se badalne wala voltage alternating kab kehlata hai? Do sharait likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Har cycle ke do bilkul yaksaan half-cycles hon, aik positive aur aik negative, yani har half-cycle ke baad polarity ulat jaye. (ii) Dono taraf peak qeemat har cycle mein aik jaisi rahe.

book_ref.quote: A periodically varying current or voltage is termed as alternating

blocks.prompt:
3 Define time period and frequency of an alternating quantity. How are they related?
(Alternating quantity ka time period aur frequency define karein. In ka aapas mein taaluq kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Time period T aik cycle poora hone ka waqt hai (seconds mein). Frequency f aik second mein cycles ki tadaad hai (hertz mein, 1 Hz = 1 cycle fi second). Taaluq: f = 1/T.

book_ref.quote: The time taken to complete one cycle of an alternating quantity is called its time period

blocks.prompt:
4 An alternating voltage completes one cycle in 0.02 s. Find its frequency and angular frequency.
(Alternating voltage 0.02 s mein aik cycle poora karta hai. Is ki frequency aur angular frequency nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Frequency (f): The number of cycles that occur in one second is called its frequency.

blocks.prompt:
5 Where does an alternating voltage change most rapidly and where most slowly?
(Alternating voltage sab se tezi se kahan aur sab se aahista kahan badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh zero (crossover) points par sab se tez aur peaks par sab se aahista badalta hai, jahan lamhe bhar ke liye maximum qeemat par hota hai.

book_ref.quote: changes occur most rapidly at the zero (crossover) points and most slowly at its peak

blocks.prompt:
6 Why is AC preferred over DC for supplying electricity between cities?
(Shehron ke darmiyan bijli ki supply ke liye AC ko DC par kyun tarjeeh di jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: AC lambe faaslon tak, do shehron ke darmiyan bhi, baghair zyada energy zaya kiye bheji ja sakti hai, jab ke DC bohat lambe faasle tak nahi bheji ja sakti kyunke is mein power zaya hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: DC cannot be transferred over a very long distance.

blocks.prompt:
7 Why is the average value of a sinusoidal AC over a full cycle zero? Over which part is the average value usually taken?
(Poore cycle par sinusoidal AC ki average qeemat zero kyun hai? Average qeemat aam tor par kis hisse par li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poore cycle (0 se 2π) par positive aur negative half-cycles aik doosre ka aks hain aur poori tarah khatam ho jaate hain, is liye average zero hai. Is liye average qeemat se murad aadhe cycle (0 se π) ka average hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This happens because the positive half-cycle and the negative half-cycle are mirror images of each other.

blocks.prompt:
8 The peak value of a full-wave rectified voltage is 50 V. Find its average value.
(Full-wave rectified voltage ki peak qeemat 50 V hai. Is ki average qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For a full-wave rectified sine wave, the average values of current and voltage are given by

blocks.prompt:
9 Define peak value and peak-to-peak value of an alternating voltage. How are they related for a sine wave?
(Alternating voltage ki peak qeemat aur peak-to-peak qeemat define karein. Sine wave ke liye in ka taaluq kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peak qeemat Vₒ aik cycle mein waveform ki sab se oonchi qeemat hai. Peak-to-peak qeemat positive peak se negative peak tak ka kul faasla hai. Symmetrical sine wave ke liye Vp-p = 2Vₒ.

book_ref.quote: It is the highest value that an AC waveform reaches during one cycle.

blocks.prompt:
10 What is instantaneous value? Write the instantaneous voltage in terms of frequency.
(Lamhati (instantaneous) qeemat kya hai? Lamhati voltage frequency ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kisi lamhe par AC quantity ki qeemat lamhati qeemat hai: V = Vₒ sin ωt. Kyunke ω = 2π/T aur f = 1/T, is liye V = Vₒ sin (2πft).

book_ref.quote: The value of an AC quantity at any instant of time is known as instantaneous value.

blocks.prompt:
11 Why are rms values used to compare an alternating current with a direct current?
(Alternating current ka direct current se muqabla karne ke liye rms qeematein kyun istemal hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: rms qeematein woh DC current ya voltage hain jo AC jitna hi hararati asar (power) paida karein, is liye yeh AC ki barabar DC qeemat batati hain: Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Iₒ, Vᵣₘₛ = 0.707 Vₒ.

book_ref.quote: The rms values represent the direct current, or voltage, values that will produce the same heating effect

blocks.prompt:
12 The rms value of a supply voltage is 120 V. Find its peak and peak-to-peak values.
(Supply voltage ki rms qeemat 120 V hai. Is ki peak aur peak-to-peak qeematein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: So, rms current, Iᵣₘₛ is equal to 0.707 Iₒ

blocks.prompt:
13 Why do high voltage power lines crackle and hiss?
(High voltage power lines chatakti aur hiss ki awaz kyun karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Corona discharge ki wajah se: taaqatwar electric field conductor ke gird hawa ko ionise (barqi zarraat mein tabdeel) kar deta hai jab voltage hawa ki breakdown taaqat se barh jaye. Is se roshni, radio noise aur hissing ki awaz paida hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: the air surrounding the conductor becomes ionized due to a strong electric field

blocks.prompt:
14 How can you tell whether a current is alternating or direct?
(Aap kaise pehchanenge ke current alternating hai ya direct?)
blocks.explanation: Current ka rukh dekhein aur maloom karein ke badalta hai ya nahi. Agar rukh waqfe waqfe se ulat jaye to AC hai; agar aik hi rukh mein bahe to DC.

book_ref.quote: Determine whether the current's direction changes or stays the same.

blocks.prompt:
15 How can the presence of AC in a wire under a carpet be detected?
(Carpet ke neeche taar mein AC ki maujoodgi kaise maloom ki ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Non-contact voltage detector (pen tester) se, jo current ke electromagnetic field ko mehsoos karke roshni ya awaz deta hai, ya AC voltage setting par multimeter se jo zyada durust naap deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Non-contact detectors will sense the electromagnetic field generated by the current

blocks.text: 17.2 Relation Between Mean Power and Maximum Power for an Alternating Current

blocks.prompt:
16 Define instantaneous power and mean power in an AC circuit.
(AC circuit mein instantaneous power aur mean power define karein.)
blocks.explanation: Instantaneous power kisi bhi lamhe t par power hai: P = VI, jahan V aur I lamhati qeematein hain. Mean power Pₘₑₐₙ AC waveform ke aik poore cycle par average power hai; resistor ke liye Pₘₑₐₙ = Iᵣₘₛ²R.

book_ref.quote: The instantaneous power P in a circuit is the power at any given moment in time t.

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is the mean power in a resistive load only half of the maximum power?
(Resistive load mein mean power maximum power ka sirf aadha kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke lamhati power cycle ke dauran badalti hai: sirf kuch points par maximum hoti hai aur kaafi waqt zero ya kam qeematon par rehti hai, is liye is ka average peak ka aadha hai: Pₘₑₐₙ = Pₘₐₓ/2.

book_ref.quote: the mean power in a resistive load is half the maximum power

blocks.prompt:
18 An rms current of 3 A flows through a 40 Ω resistor. Find the mean power and the peak power.
(40 Ω resistor mein 3 A rms current behti hai. Mean power aur peak power nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Also we have expression for the mean power Pₘₑₐₙ represented by

blocks.prompt:
19 What is a resistive load?
(Resistive load kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resistive load woh hai jo capacitor ya inductor ki tarah energy store nahi karta, balke sirf hararat ki shakal mein kharch kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: A resistive load is one that does not store energy

blocks.prompt:
20 Define phase of an alternating quantity. Give the phases of the points at the start, the positive peak and the end of one cycle.
(Alternating quantity ka phase define karein. Aik cycle ke shuru, positive peak aur aakhir ke points ke phase batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Phase woh angle θ (= ωt) hai jo alternating voltage ya current ki lamhati qeemat batata hai. Cycle ke shuru par phase 0, positive peak par π/2 aur cycle ke aakhir par 2π hai.

book_ref.quote: The angle θ which specifies the instantaneous value of the alternating voltage or current is called the phase.

blocks.prompt:
21 What is initial phase? What is meant by the current leading the voltage?
(Initial phase kya hai? Current ke voltage se aage (lead) hone se kya murad hai?)
blocks.explanation: t = 0 par phase angle initial phase hai. Agar V = Vₒ sin θ aur I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ) ho to t = 0 par V = 0 magar I = Iₒ sin φ; current φ pehle zero se guzri, is liye current voltage se φ aage hai.

book_ref.quote: the value of the phase angle θ at t equals to zero is called the initial phase

blocks.prompt:
22 Differentiate between current leading and current lagging the voltage.
(Current ke voltage se aage (lead) aur peeche (lag) hone mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Lead: current voltage se pehle zero tak pohanchti hai; lag: baad mein.

book_ref.quote: It means that the current I will reach its zero value later on by an angle φ than the voltage V.

rows: I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ), jab V = Vₒ sin θ.
I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ), jab V = Vₒ sin θ.
t = 0 par I = +Iₒ sin φ.
t = 0 par I = −Iₒ sin φ.
Current φ pehle zero tak pohanchti hai.
Current φ baad mein zero tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt:
23 State the conditions for representing an alternating quantity by a rotating vector.
(Alternating quantity ko ghoomne wale vector se zahir karne ki sharait bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Vector anticlockwise ghoomta hai aur (i) scale par is ki lambai peak ya rms qeemat batati hai; (ii) jab quantity zero ho aur positive taraf barh rahi ho tab horizontal hota hai; (iii) is ki angular frequency quantity ki angular frequency ke barabar hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: An alternating quantity can be represented by an anticlockwise rotating vector

blocks.prompt:
24 Name the basic circuit elements of DC and AC circuits.
(DC aur AC circuits ke bunyadi circuit elements ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: DC circuit ka bunyadi element resistor R hai jo Ohm's law V = IR ke zariye current aur voltage control karta hai. AC circuit ke bunyadi elements resistor R, inductor L aur capacitor C hain.

book_ref.quote: But the basic circuit elements in AC circuit are resistor R, inductor L and capacitor C.

blocks.prompt:
25 Show that voltage and current are in phase in a purely resistive AC circuit.
(Sabit karein ke khaalis resistive AC circuit mein voltage aur current in phase hain.)
blocks.explanation: V = Vₒ sin ωt ho to I = V/R = (Vₒ/R) sin ωt = Iₒ sin ωt. Dono aik hi ωt ke sine functions hain, is liye aik hi waqt maximum aur minimum se guzarte hain: in phase hain.

book_ref.quote: both voltage and current pass their minimum and maximum values at the same time

blocks.prompt:
26 Why does the power dissipated in a resistor not depend on the direction of the current?
(Resistor mein kharch hone wali power current ke rukh par munhasir kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke power current ke murabba (square) ke mutanasib hai (P = I²R). Current positive ho ya negative, murabba positive hi hota hai, is liye DC ya AC se farq nahi parta.

book_ref.quote: The power dissipation is proportional to the square of the current

blocks.prompt:
27 A 1.2 kW heater works on a 240 V AC supply. Find the current taken and the resistance of the heater when hot.
(1.2 kW heater 240 V AC supply par chalta hai. Li jane wali current aur garam halat mein resistance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A 1 kW heating element is connected to a 250 V AC supply voltage.

blocks.prompt:
28 Why are doorbells often operated on 12 V AC?
(Doorbells aksar 12 V AC par kyun chalayi jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kam voltage wali AC sambhalne mein zyada mehfooz hai aur bijli ke jhatke (shock) ka khatra kam karti hai.

book_ref.quote: 12 V A.C DOORBELL Low-voltage AC is safer to handle

blocks.prompt:
29 What is an inductor? How does it slow down current surges?
(Inductor kya hai? Yeh current ke achanak ubhaar (surges) ko kaise dheema karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inductor (coil ya choke) do terminal wala passive component hai jis ki self-inductance bari aur resistance na hone ke barabar hoti hai; yeh magnetic field mein energy store karta hai. Surges ko yeh energy waqti tor par field mein rakh kar aur phir circuit ko wapas de kar dheema karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The inductor is used to slow down current surges or spikes

blocks.prompt:
30 Define inductive reactance. On what factors does it depend?
(Inductive reactance define karein. Yeh kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inductive reactance X_L inductor ki taraf se AC ki mukhalfat hai: X_L = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = ωL = 2πfL. Yeh frequency f aur inductance L ke seedha mutanasib hai. Unit ohm hai.

book_ref.quote: The resistance offered by an inductor is called inductive reactance

blocks.prompt:
31 Why does an inductor allow DC but block AC?
(Inductor DC ko guzarne aur AC ko rokne wala kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: X_L = 2πfL. DC ke liye f = 0, to X_L = 0 aur koi reactance nahi. Zyada frequency wali AC ke liye X_L bari hoti hai, is liye inductor AC ko rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, we conclude that an inductor allows DC but blocks the AC.

blocks.prompt:
32 Find the inductive reactance of a 50 mH coil at 1 kHz.
(1 kHz par 50 mH coil ki inductive reactance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: It shows that inductive reactance X_L is directly proportional to both

blocks.prompt:
33 Why is the average power dissipated in a pure inductor zero?
(Khaalis inductor mein average power zero kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khaalis inductor mein voltage aur current mein 90° ka phase farq hai. Inductor aik chauthai cycle mein magnetic field mein energy store karta aur agle mein source ko wapas kar deta hai, is liye cycle ki average power zero hai.

book_ref.quote: The average power dissipated in a pure inductor is zero.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lamhati power P = ½VₒIₒ sin 2ωt aik chauthai cycle positive (energy store) aur agli chauthai negative (energy wapas) hoti hai; dono barabar hain, is liye average zero. Kitab ka yeh kehna ke lamhati power bhi zero hai durust nahi.

blocks.prompt:
34 A coil of 0.3 H and negligible resistance carries an rms current of 10 mA at 200 Hz. Find the rms voltage across it.
(0.3 H aur na hone ke barabar resistance wali coil mein 200 Hz par 10 mA rms current hai. Is par rms voltage nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Inductance of the coil L = 400 mH = 400 × 10⁻³ H

blocks.prompt:
35 What is a choke? Why is its inductance very high?
(Choke kya hai? Is ki inductance bohat zyada kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Choke moti copper wire ki coil hai jo soft iron laminated core par bohat se turns mein qareeb qareeb lapeti jati hai. Iron core ki zyada permeability (magnetic guzargahi) ki wajah se is ki inductance bohat zyada hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a coil of thick copper wire wound closely in a large number of turns over a soft iron laminated core.

blocks.prompt:
36 Why is practically no power dissipated as heat in a choke coil?
(Choke coil mein amalan hararat ki shakal mein power kyun zaya nahi hoti?)
blocks.explanation: Choke ki resistance bohat kam aur reactance bohat zyada hai, is liye power factor cos θ taqreeban zero aur θ taqreeban 90° hai. P = VI cos θ se amalan koi power hararat mein zaya nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: So practically, no power is dissipated as heat by a choke coil.

blocks.prompt:
37 Give two uses of choke coils in electronic circuits.
(Electronic circuits mein choke coils ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Electronic circuits se zyada frequency wala AC noise saaf karti hain, jis se saaf DC output milta hai. (ii) Switch-mode power supplies mein voltage regulate karne aur switching noise saaf karne mein madad karti hain. Yeh RF signals ko circuit se bahar nikalne se bhi rokti hain.

book_ref.quote: Choke coils are used to filter out high frequency AC noise from electronic circuits

blocks.prompt:
38 What is the role of a choke in a fluorescent light?
(Fluorescent light mein choke ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Choke tube par lamhati (transient) voltages paida karta hai jo andar ki gas ko breakdown voltage tak pohanchate hain aur tube jal uthti hai. Choke current ki tabdeeli ki raftaar bhi mehdood karta hai jis se insulation surges se bachti hai.

book_ref.quote: Chokes in fluorescent lights generate transient voltages across the tube

blocks.prompt:
39 Why does a capacitor block DC while an inductor allows it?
(Capacitor DC ko kyun rokta hai jab ke inductor guzarne deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DC ke liye f = 0. To X_L = 2πfL = 0, inductor conductor ki tarah hai; magar X_C = 1/(2πfC) = 1/0 = ∞, is liye capacitor DC ko rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Why capacitor and inductor behaves differently for AC and DC?

blocks.prompt:
40 How does alternating current flow in a circuit containing a capacitor when no charge crosses its insulating medium?
(Capacitor wale circuit mein AC kaise behti hai jab ke charge insulating medium paar nahi karta?)
blocks.explanation: Voltage ulatne par capacitor pehle aik rukh aur phir doosre rukh charge hota hai. Is liye electrons plates ko jorne wale circuit mein aage peeche harkat karte hain, yahi alternating current hai.

book_ref.quote: But alternating current can pass through a capacitor.

blocks.prompt:
41 Define capacitive reactance and write its formula and unit.
(Capacitive reactance define karein aur is ka formula aur unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Capacitive reactance X_C capacitor ki taraf se AC ki mukhalfat hai: X_C = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = 1/ωC = 1/(2πfC). Unit ohm hai.

book_ref.quote: Resistance offered by capacitor is known as capacitive reactance

blocks.prompt:
42 How does the current through a capacitor change with the frequency of the supply?
(Supply ki frequency ke saath capacitor mein current kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: X_C = 1/(2πfC). Kam frequency par X_C bari aur current kam; zyada frequency par X_C chhoti aur usi capacitor mein current zyada.

book_ref.quote: for low frequencies, capacitor will have a large reactance X_C and current I will be small

blocks.prompt:
43 Find the reactance of a 2 μF capacitor at 1 kHz.
(1 kHz par 2 μF capacitor ki reactance nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The unit of capacitive reactance X_C is ohm and is given as:

blocks.prompt:
44 Differentiate between the behaviour of an inductor and a capacitor in AC circuits.
(AC circuits mein inductor aur capacitor ke bartao mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Inductor mein current voltage se 90° peeche; capacitor mein 90° aage.

book_ref.quote: Unlike a resistor, a capacitor behaves differently in AC and DC circuits.

rows: Current voltage se 90° peeche (lag).
Current voltage se 90° aage (lead).
X_L = 2πfL, frequency ke saath barhti hai.
X_C = 1/(2πfC), frequency ke saath ghatti hai.
DC guzarta hai (f = 0 par X_L = 0).
DC rokta hai (f = 0 par X_C = ∞).
Magnetic field mein energy store karta hai.
Electric field mein energy store karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
45 Who is called the father of alternating currents and why?
(Alternating currents ka baap kise kaha jata hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Nikola Tesla (paidaish 1856, 1884 mein U.S.A. gaye). Unhon ne alternating current ki paidaish, tarseel aur istemal ki bunyad rakhi, jo DC se kahin zyada faasle tak bheji ja sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Nikola Tesla was born in 1856 in Austria-Hungary

blocks.prompt:
46 Define impedance and give its SI unit.
(Impedance define karein aur is ki SI unit batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Impedance Z AC circuit mein resistance aur reactances ka mila jula asar hai. Yeh rms voltage aur rms current ki nisbat hai: Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ. SI unit ohm hai.

book_ref.quote: The combined effect of resistance and reactances in such circuits is known as impedance.

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between resistance and reactance.
(Resistance aur reactance mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Resistance resistors ki mukhalfat; reactance capacitors aur inductors ki mukhalfat.

book_ref.quote: Reactance is the opposition to current flow due to capacitors

rows: Resistors ki wajah se current ki mukhalfat.
Inductors (X_L) aur capacitors (X_C) ki wajah se mukhalfat.
DC aur AC dono mein aik jaisi; V aur I in phase.
Frequency par munhasir (X_L = 2πfL, X_C = 1/2πfC); V aur I mein 90° farq.
Energy hararat ban kar zaya hoti hai.
Average power zaya nahi hoti; energy store ho kar wapas milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
48 A circuit draws an rms current of 2.2 A from a 110 V rms supply. Find its impedance.
(Aik circuit 110 V rms supply se 2.2 A rms current leta hai. Is ki impedance nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = 110/2.2 = 50 Ω.

book_ref.quote: It is the ratio of the rms value of the voltage to the rms value of the current.

blocks.prompt:
49 What is an impedance diagram? Draw its idea for an RC-series circuit in words.
(Impedance diagram kya hai? RC-series circuit ke liye is ka khaaka alfaaz mein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Impedance diagram mein R current (reference) ke saath horizontal line hai; X_C = 1/ωC, R line se 90° peeche banayi jati hai. In ka vector jama impedance Z = √(R² + X_C²) hai, aur Z ka R line se angle phase angle θ hai.

book_ref.quote: The impedance Z of the circuit is obtained by the vector summation of resistance and reactance.

blocks.prompt:
50 Why is the power in an RC-series circuit consumed only by the resistor?
(RC-series circuit mein power sirf resistor mein kyun kharch hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capacitor sirf electric field mein energy store karke wapas karta hai, zaya nahi karta. Is liye power resistor mein kharch hoti hai: P = I²R = VI cos θ.

book_ref.quote: The power consumed in RC-series circuit is primarily due to the resistor

blocks.prompt:
51 An 80 Ω resistor is in series with a capacitor of reactance 60 Ω. Find the impedance and the phase angle.
(80 Ω resistor 60 Ω reactance wale capacitor ke saath series mein hai. Impedance aur phase angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Z = √(80² + 60²) = 100 Ω. θ = tan⁻¹(60/80) = 36.9°, current voltage se aage.

book_ref.quote: Equation 17.21 suggests that we can find the impedance of a series AC circuit by vector addition.

blocks.prompt:
52 Write the phase relations of V_R and V_L with the current in an RL-series circuit and the resulting rms voltage.
(RL-series circuit mein V_R aur V_L ke current se phase taaluqaat aur natija rms voltage likhein.)
blocks.explanation: V_R = IᵣₘₛR current ke saath in phase; V_L = IᵣₘₛX_L current se 90° aage. In ka vector jama Vᵣₘₛ = √(V_R² + V_L²) = Iᵣₘₛ√(R² + ω²L²).

book_ref.quote: Voltage V across L is ahead of current I through L by 90°

blocks.prompt:
53 A 12 Ω resistor is in series with a coil of reactance 5 Ω. Find the impedance and phase angle.
(12 Ω resistor 5 Ω reactance wali coil ke saath series mein hai. Impedance aur phase angle nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Z = √(144 + 25) = 13 Ω. θ = tan⁻¹(5/12) = 22.6°, voltage current se aage.

book_ref.quote: Consider an AC circuit containing a resistor R and inductor L connected in series

blocks.prompt:
54 How does an electric eel produce powerful shocks?
(Electric eel taaqatwar jhatke kaise paida karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Apne 3 bare organs ke zariye jo jism ki lambai ka taqreeban 80% hain aur electrocytes naam ke khaas cells se bane hain (kitab 'electrolytes' likhti hai jo bijli guzarne wale mehlool hain).

book_ref.quote: through specialized cells called electrolytes

blocks.prompt:
55 What is power factor? What is its value for a pure resistor?
(Power factor kya hai? Khaalis resistor ke liye is ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: P = VI cos θ mein cos θ, jahan θ voltage aur current ka phase angle hai, power factor kehlata hai. Khaalis resistor mein θ = 0, is liye power factor 1 hai.

book_ref.quote: The factor cos θ is known as power factor.

blocks.prompt:
56 A DC solar panel gives 600 W to an inverter of efficiency 85%. How much AC power is received?
(DC solar panel 85% efficiency wale inverter ko 600 W deta hai. Kitni AC power milegi?)

book_ref.quote: So, we can find AC power from DC power by using the following conversion as:

blocks.prompt:
57 About how much electricity does a 1.5 ton air conditioner use in one hour?
